title: SAP Vigilance Clearance Management System
description: Enterprise SAP ABAP application for managing vigilance clearance requests, approvals, tracking, and reporting.
longDescription: Developed a SAP Module Pool application for managing vigilance clearance requests with role-based processing, request tracking, bulk operations, ALV reporting, approval workflows, custom database tables, and Open SQL.

title: DIYElectro - E-Commerce Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for electronic components with customer and admin modules.
longDescription: Built a complete e-commerce application with user authentication, OTP verification, product management, shopping cart, wishlist, order management, customer dashboard, and admin management features.

title: ShopCraft - Microservices E-Commerce Platform
description: E-commerce platform built with independent backend services and REST-based communication.
longDescription: Designed an e-commerce system using a microservices architecture with independent services for authentication, products, users, orders, and notifications. Implemented REST-based service communication and containerized services using Docker.

title: Medical Claim Report
description: SAP ABAP ALV reporting solution for employee medical claim processing.
longDescription: Developed an interactive SAP ABAP ALV report with dynamic selection filters, latest-version claim selection, claim summaries, database joins, and optimized Open SQL queries for medical claim processing.

title: Employee Management System
description: Web application for managing employee records with authentication, authorization, and CRUD operations.
longDescription: Developed a role-based employee management application with authentication, authorization, profile management, employee CRUD operations, and REST API integration.

title: 3D Printer
description: Custom embedded systems project for 3D printer control, monitoring, and automation.
longDescription: Developed a custom 3D printer system involving printer control, temperature monitoring, serial communication, firmware configuration, and hardware integration using Arduino and Marlin firmware.

title: ESP32 RFID Attendance System
description: RFID-based attendance system using ESP32 with a web interface for managing attendance records.
longDescription: Developed an RFID attendance system using ESP32 for card reading and attendance capture, with a web-based interface for viewing and managing attendance records.
